_about: End-credits screenplay: how the credits in credits.json appear on screen, card by card, and the tail card that closes each episode.
Every episode's scene s99 plays these cards, then its tail ('next_time' for Episodes 1-3, 'finale' for Episode 4).  check_outline.py checks the length of s99 against this file.
There is no dialogue, so timing is fixed here in seconds.  Each card must stay up long enough to read: at least 1 second plus 1 second per 4 words, and never less than 3 seconds.
A card with 'when' plays only in episodes where that thing is used.  If it is used only in optional scenes, the card's time counts toward the episode's optional budget.

music._comment: Not yet chosen; see the candidates in titles/outline.json.  The roll is about 52 seconds with its tail (59 with the Euphemia card), so the piece will need a cut or a loop point.

cards.staging: Three cards deal face down onto the table and flip, one name on each face.
The paper's title page slides in beside the cards; the credit is typed under it.
cards.character_action: Ada taps the page as if checking the citation

cards.staging: Each name appears beside the picture it gave the series: Curtis by the kitten, Conway by the MINIMOG, Witt by a glowing hexad, Kahane and Ryba by the card table, Conway and Sloane by a stack of books.
cards.character_action: Sophie walks along the line of pictures

cards.staging: The four kittens step forward in a row and bow in turn; each one's name, then voice, appears beneath.
cards.character_action: Pascal bows too low and topples; Euler bows a beat late

cards.staging: Professor Euphemia nods from a doorway; the note appears beside her.
The credit writes itself along a staff line that curls into the shape of a tail.
The tools' names drop onto the table like cards, one per tool.
The kittens' stick-figure rigs appear briefly, then fill back in.
The 132 hexads tick past as dots in a counter, which stops at 132.

next_time.staging: The next episode's subtitle picture (from titles/outline.json) fades up behind the text; that episode's lead kitten peeks in from the edge of frame.

finale.staging: The cards, the kitten, the MINIMOG and the graph gather into a single deck; all four kittens sit in a row in front of it.
